newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Second Taiwan teenager reported kidnapped, killed.
Food poisoning cases surge, with 17 cases reported so far in May.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Premier Lien Chan denies he will form multi-partisan cabinet.
LIBERTY TIMES - Ruling Nationalist Party succeeds in preventing opposition parties' bid to pass motion in parliament to sack Premier Lien.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Some 50 local textile firms invited to visit Taiwan-promoted industrial zone in Central America.
Electronics sector is investors' safe haven in recent stock market downward corrections.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Securities watchdog chief says will not orchestrate stock market rally in run-up to first anniversary of President Lee Teng-hui's May 20 inauguration.
First-quarter gross domestic product growth likely will exceed 6.6 percent year-on-year.
